sentences.en: Opaque? Not at all. Intuitively obvious to the most casual observer.
sentences.zh: 一点也不不透明，反而非常显而易见。

sentences.en: You don't know what that small opaque bottle contains.
sentences.zh: 你不知道那个小瓶子里装的是什么。

sentences.en: This is one of the world's most opaque regimes.
sentences.zh: 这是世界上最不透明的政权之一。

senses.zh: 不透明的；不传热的；迟钝的
